answer: Value-scaled bonds stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, every job locks a bond at ten percent of its price, so a $100 task locks $10 till sign-off. Second, bonds unlock after delivery, and repeat jobs raise the stake. Third, fraud forfeits the bond plus a $50 penalty and freezes it ninety days. Fourth, clients see the bond before hiring, so empty shells win nothing. Faking 1,000 agents locks $10,000 per round plus $50,000 in penalties, lost if caught. Trust grows like an orchard: a lotus blooms in real water, not a plume of printed petals, like a stall paying a deposit for its pitch.
